title: Demonstration at PURA against mobile-data price floor
location: Public Utilities Regulatory Authority headquarters, Kairaba Avenue, Kanifing
scope: stationary public demonstration against a Gambian regulator's tariff directive
organizer: Team Gom Sa Bopa, GALA and EFSCRJ are named by Askanwi; the same source describes organizer coalition
participants_original: 19 people reportedly arrested; total attendance not reported
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved: the opened Askanwi account reports 19 arrests but no total attendance. Arrest count establishes at least 19 attendees, not 50.

start_date.summary: Opened account dates the demonstration to Friday, 22 August.

end_date.summary: No explicit duration/end date for the gathering; unknown.

location.summary: Opened account places demonstration outside PURA headquarters on Kairaba Avenue.

scope.summary: Public stationary demonstration against a decision by Gambian regulatory authority PURA.

organizer.summary: Askanwi names Team Gom Sa Bopa, GALA and EFSCRJ as organizing the demonstration.

demands.summary: Protesters demanded suspension of the D50-per-GB floor and heed to the consumer competition commission; code as price/tariff policy.

participants_original.summary: The opened account states 19 persons were arrested but gives no total attendance.

participants_min.summary: At least 19 participants are directly implied by the reported arrests.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Only 19 arrests specified; total group size remains unknown, so >=50 is unproven.

protester_violence.summary: Askanwi explicitly describes the demonstration as peaceful and says it proceeded without procession/loudspeakers.

state_response.summary: Askanwi reports police dispersed the demonstrators and arrested 19; exact official account differs and is not opened.

notes: Do not infer >=50 from the number of arrested. Other search-only accounts report 19 or 23 arrests and are not independent evidence of total attendance. The demonstration is distinct from later court and prison-related actions.
open_questions: Total attendance at the 22 August gathering.
Independent contemporary reporting on participant count and police response.
Whether same-story/syndication links exist among local reports.

title: Court gathering against remand of PURA-protest detainees
scope: reported crowd calling for detainees' release as court remanded protesters
threshold_50_evidence: Search-only Standard result describes a 'huge gathering' at the court, but no body has been opened and the attendance claim remains unverified.

start_date.summary: Search result dates the court gathering to 25 August; not body-verified.

location.summary: Search result locates crowd at Kanifing court.

scope.summary: Search result describes people demanding release of remanded protesters; public gathering status and details need body verification.

demands.summary: Search result identifies demand to release detained protesters.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: 'Huge gathering' is a search-result phrase only; attendance threshold remains unverified.

state_response.summary: Possible police tear-gas response is reported in search result only; uncoded pending body-level evidence.

notes: Distinct date from the 22 August PURA demonstration and 26 August march, but relationship/continuity needs confirmation. Search snippets are discovery only.
open_questions: Whether a distinct public gathering occurred and its actual size.
Full contemporaneous reporting of the court scene.
Whether the court crowd and later march were coordinated actions.

title: March toward National Assembly over detention of PURA protesters
location: Near Mile Two Central Prison, marching toward Banjul/National Assembly
scope: reported public march demanding release of detainees from prior PURA demonstration
participants_original: 15 marchers were reported arrested; total attendance unknown
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved: search result reports 15 arrests but provides no total march attendance.

start_date.summary: Search result dates march to 26 August.

location.summary: Search result says march was intercepted near Mile Two while heading toward Banjul.

scope.summary: Search result describes protest over detention of 23 youths.

participants_original.summary: Fifteen arrests reported; number of total participants unknown.

participants_min.summary: At least 15 participants are reported arrested.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Arrest count falls below 50 and total march attendance is unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Not coded from the search-only account.

state_response.summary: Arrest/interception details remain search-only and are not coded.

notes: Potentially distinct from the 25 August court crowd; open evidence needed to determine continuity and event boundary.
open_questions: Whether this and the court crowd are one campaign episode or separate gatherings.
